description: This file defines the QueryObject class used for constructing, validating, and processing query parameters within the Superset data visualization platform. It includes methods for managing query attributes, validation, cache key generation, and post-processing of dataframes.

classes.name: QueryObject
classes.description: Represents a query with attributes for columns, metrics, filters, and other parameters; includes methods for validation, serialization, cache key generation, and post-processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a QueryObject with provided query parameters, handling deprecated fields and setting defaults.

methods.name: _set_annotation_layers
methods.description: Filters out formula annotation layers from the annotation layers list.

methods.name: _set_is_timeseries
methods.description: Determines if the query is a timeseries based on the presence of a time column.

methods.name: _set_metrics
methods.description: Processes and sets the metrics list, supporting different formats including adhoc metrics.

methods.name: _set_post_processing
methods.description: Filters out null post-processing steps.

methods.name: _init_series_columns
methods.description: Initializes series columns based on input, metrics, and timeseries status.

methods.name: _rename_deprecated_fields
methods.description: Handles renaming of deprecated query fields.

methods.name: _move_deprecated_extra_fields
methods.description: Moves deprecated extra fields into the extras dictionary.

methods.name: metric_names
methods.description: Returns list of metric names, converting adhoc metrics to strings.

methods.name: column_names
methods.description: Returns list of column names, prioritizing groupby columns if both are present.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the query object, checking for missing series, duplicates, and invalid time offsets.

methods.name: _validate_no_have_duplicate_labels
methods.description: Checks for duplicate labels among metrics and columns.

methods.name: _validate_time_offsets
methods.description: Validates the format and feature flag status of time offsets.

methods.name: _is_valid_date_range
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid date range in YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: _sanitize_filters
methods.description: Sanitizes WHERE and HAVING clauses, including Jinja processing and dialect transpilation.

methods.name: _validate_there_are_no_missing_series
methods.description: Ensures all series columns are present in the main columns list.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Serializes the query object into a dictionary for caching or transmission.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representation of the query object.

methods.name: cache_key
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on the query parameters, considering impersonation and annotations.

methods.name: exec_post_processing
methods.description: Applies post-processing operations to a DataFrame, supporting custom operations.
